transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I've been feeling really down and have completely lost interest in everything I used to enjoy. I just don't have the motivation to do anything anymore. It's been like this for about two years and three months now.
Have you had any periods of at least two months during this time when you felt back to your usual self?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. It has been completely continuous and ongoing for the entire two years and three months. I haven't felt like my usual self even for a short period during this time.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Persistent Depressive Disorder, Major Depressive Disorder], but the patient reports a continuous depressed mood and loss of interest for about two years and three months with no symptom-free period of at least two months. That chronic, non-episodic course makes Major Depressive Disorder less likely and supports Persistent Depressive Disorder.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports a chronically depressed mood with marked loss of interest and low motivation lasting 2 years and 3 months, with no symptom-free period of 2 months or more. This continuous long-duration course is most consistent with Persistent Depressive Disorder rather than Major Depressive Disorder or Adjustment Disorder.
